name: Cryptopanic bearish-vote divergence — loud pessimism price refuses to confirm (long)
rationale: MECHANISM: cryptopanic votes are a direct, granular retail tally distinct from the composite fear_greed. When bearish votes are HIGH but price does NOT confirm — price holds a support, range_position is NOT making new lows — it signals loud retail pessimism the tape refuses to validate: capitulation-without-follow-through, which historically precedes short-term rebounds. Counterparty: informed flow quietly absorbing while the crowd shouts. The DIVERGENCE (sentiment vs price) is the alpha, not sentiment alone. Entry: cryptopanic_bearish_votes above a fitted spike AND range_position above a fitted floor (price holding, not breaking down). Long; exit when votes subside or price breaks out, or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: check per-symbol vote coverage FIRST — thin data collapses effective-N and the Gate kills it. If bearish-vote spikes predict returns EQUALLY whether or not price diverges (range_position high vs low), the 'divergence' framing is fake and it is just a bearish-vote contrarian — test that simpler form instead.
catalyst: bearish votes spike while price holds its range (divergence)
